news.title: Deepgram launches marketplace with 19 voice AI partners
Deepgram to Acquire Daily for a Complete Conversational Voice AI Stack

bullets: Own the enterprise adoption problem space end to end: the procurement, security, compliance, and UX storylines that have to work together to win upmarket deals.
Set strategy, sequencing across enterprise initiatives which today includes SSO, compliance readiness, and our Console UX, and defend that prioritization with data.
Ship solutions on whatever surface fits the problem: Console, APIs, or the managed endpoint. You own the problem and partner with the PMs who own those surfaces rather than owning…
Drive enterprise security and compliance readiness so procurement teams can self-serve e.g., SBOM generation and security-artifact access, instead of waiting on us.
Remove the product blockers that stall deals in security review and slow closure.
Own the strategy for Deepgram’s AI applications: decide which products the line consists of, who they are for, and why they win; write it down; defend it to executives; and keep…
Own the roadmap and its decisions — what ships, in what order, with which tradeoffs — from the applications we have today to the ones we have not built yet.
Build the business: acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, with the metrics, the targets, and a weekly read of whether the product is working and the business is…
Represent the product with partners and customers, and own what we commit to deliver and when.
Run the team’s operating rhythm — a hypothesis, a shipped change, an honest measurement, the next bet — with real usage by real people as the bar, starting with Deepgram’s own…

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Agentic Experiences (Former Engineer)

bullets: Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.
Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent…
Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.
Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.
